# Cost model check (generated by experiments/cost_model.py)

Fitted on 136 runs (seeds 0-1), tested on 204 runs (seeds 2-4) that were never used for fitting.

| Model | Fitted numbers | Median error on test runs |
|---|---|---|
| A: time = a x scans | a = 1.51e-07 s per scan | 41% |
| B: time = a x scans + b x path edges | a = 1.26e-07 s per scan, b = 1.27e-06 s per path edge | 24% |
